record.description: Executable checker for phase ordering, dwell time and exit/rest constraints; emits named violations and bounded receipt. It audits declared traces rather than diagnosing a person.
record.note: The implemented sequence auditor rejects action before notice, naming before world answer, and assessment before world answer. Equal integer ticks are permitted. Minimum dwell and required rest or exit are separately declared constraints.
